LIB_MOVE.description: Reader moves one cell on a shortest path to the help desk.
LIB_MOVE.effect: move one legal cell toward desk

LIB_QUEUE.description: Arriving reader joins the service queue for the next step.
LIB_QUEUE.effect: append to queue for next step

LIB_SERVE.description: Open desk serves at most one previously queued reader.
LIB_SERVE.effect: serve one reader and remove from queue

LIB_READ.description: Reader without a help request keeps reading.
conditions: reader has no help request and is reading

WORK_MOVE.description: Worker moves to counter or workstation along a shortest path.

WORK_QUEUE.description: Arriving worker joins loan or return queue for the next step.
WORK_QUEUE.effect: append to loan or return queue for next step

WORK_LOAN.description: Storekeeper lends one available drill to a queued worker.

WORK_RETURN.description: Storekeeper accepts one returned drill before any loan.
conditions: worker with drill queued to return before step
WORK_RETURN.effect: transfer one drill to counter and complete job

WORK_JOB.description: Worker holding a drill completes one work unit at workstation.
